# deed_project (Resource)

A Deed project: the organizational and security scope that owns entities, sources and relationships. Every project is created with the system sources `api`, `terraform`, `ui` and `overrides`. Requires an installation `admin` (or owner) token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "deed_project" "homelab" {
  name         = "homelab"
  display_name = "Home lab"
  description  = "Servers, services and repositories of the home lab."

  # Allow plain http:// links (for example to appliances on the LAN).
  allow_http_links = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Project name: a lowercase slug (a-z, 0-9, -) of at most 63 characters, unique in the installation. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `allow_http_links` (Boolean) Allow plain `http://` entity links in this project (default `false`: https only).
- `description` (String) Description (Markdown).
- `display_name` (String) Human-friendly name. Defaults to `name`.
- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Delete the project even when it still contains entities contributed by other sources (imports, observations, other Terraform configurations). Default `false`: destroying a project that still has live entities fails.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Project ID (`prj_…`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import deed_project.homelab homelab # project name or ID
```
